notes: Fix: the Deepcore Crafting Table now has every Deepcore recipe. The 41 blocks and items added since the table came out were missing from its recipe book: the Mining Suit and its modules (Fire Protection, Jetpack, Speed and more), Jetpacks, Drills, Portable Terminals, the reactor and matrix parts, Mining Portal blocks, Teleporter Pads, the Robit, the Chargepad, the Crate Link and the network blocks (Network Cable, Core, Terminal, Crafter, Deepcore Chest, Order Processor). They are on the Deepcore tab and in search, and new ones will be added automatically from now on. Also in this build (4.46): a Basic Item Vacuum, Chunk Loader, Mob Repeller or Lava Pump shows its Range slot as closed until it is Steel.
